about:
Setup

Cyberpunk 2077: a captured game clip, 4K output, upscaler Balanced (render 2259x1271), NR at full scale. Same settings as the 0.0.9-split.1 preview (its default preset, 1 pass; Stellar Blade with its own reuse settings: no revealed-background fill, Snap on). Every picture then goes through FSR 4 Lite lossy (4.1.2l-lossy, the 2026-11-19 build) at 4K.

What to look at

A fast pan past a pillar (full frame). The hardest of these clips: fast motion and a lot of background revealed behind the pillar. Revealed background is filled with the nearby edit instead of showing the unedited picture as a dark outline.

Numbers

Against the reference (PSNR, whole 4K frame): this build 34.6 dB on frame 74, NR off 30.7 dB; over the whole clip 35.2 vs 30.9 dB. Least close frame of the clip: frame 46, 29.6 dB.

Notes

Frames from captured game clips, run through the plugin's own runtime in a test harness (deterministic, one run each); the display mapping is ours (x/(1+x), gamma 1/2.2), not the game's tone mapping; no UI. Built on DLSSNR-AMD (TheAutomatic and contributors) and the RDNA3 ports by mauri870 and hedonemaeda. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by NVIDIA or AMD.
